name: Milky Journey Railway
original_name: ミルキージャーニー・レイルウェイ
source:
The girl who woke up in the "Galaxy Railway" had no memory.

The crew members on board call her "Princess" and welcome her on their journey through the galaxy.

The Galaxy Railway carrying them goes around the stars without deciding on a destination.

[Translated from [url=https://www.animategames.jp/home/detail/40214]Animate Games[/url]]
translation:
在“银河铁道”上醒来的女孩失去了记忆。

船员们称她为“公主”，欢迎她加入穿越银河的旅程。

载着他们的银河铁道穿行于群星之间，却始终没有确定目的地。

[译自[url=https://www.animategames.jp/home/detail/40214]Animate Games[/url]]
